en: Maxie
The meteorite's energy, poured into the heart of the volcano... Mt. Chimney will erupt, and the land will grow!
So. You're the child who keeps turning up wherever Team Magma has work to do.
I am Maxie, Team Magma's leader. More land for people and Pokémon to live on: that is our dream.
I won't let a meddler stand in its way. Show me what you have!
Hmph. Beaten by a child, here of all places...
Very well. I'll leave the volcano be, for now. But Team Magma is far from finished. Remember that.
Archie
Ha! You saw Maxie off all by yourself. I'll admit it, I'm impressed.
If that volcano had gone up, the sea would have been the one to pay for it. Team Aqua owes you one.
We'll be on our way. Keep your eyes open, kid. Team Magma won't stay quiet for long.
Archie
You again! Team Magma's set that meteorite in a machine up there, and they mean to wake the volcano with it.
My crew's got our hands full with their grunts. Get up there and stop Maxie, would you?
Go on, stop Maxie! We'll keep his grunts busy down here!
A meteorite is fitted into the machine. It doesn't seem to be doing anything any more.
Take the meteorite out of the machine?
A meteorite is fitted into the machine, which hums as it soaks up the meteorite's strange energy.
The machine sits silent. It doesn't respond to anything.
Old Woman
Ah, a climber! Up here we bake Lava Cookies in the volcano's own heat.
Would you like one? It's just 200 money.
Here you are! Share it with your Pokémon. They'll love it.
That's a pity. They're the best on the mountain, you know.
Oh dear, you're a little short. Come back when you have the money.
